nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE.

nodes.text: Hey, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Can I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure! Dip a toe in! The water's perfect.
$ALLISON sits down next to $ZOE and dips her feet into the water.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ooh. You were not mistaken in the least!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, what's up? You look a little troubled?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I am. I... I heard there was a time when you had the interest of two different guys.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, yeah. That seems so long ago, but yep! At one point, both Owen and Howard wanted to be with me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How'd you handle such a complicated situation?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if I handled it in the best way...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, circumstance played a big role. Howard was in college... So, it just wasn't going to work out.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But you're currently romantically entwined with him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it turns out that we're not very good apart.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What I `can` tell you, and what I would have told me if I'd had the chance...
nodes.text_bbcode: What I [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] tell you, and what I would have told me if I'd had the chance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Is that you owe it to whoever's interested in you to be honest about your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But what if I don't know who to be with?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, $ALLISON.
$ALLISON looks into the water for a moment, her reflection staring back at her.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Where is Howard, by the way?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I think he's over there with some of the football guys. He's been acting really weird the last couple days.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: Uh, some of those guys aren't Centerscore guys!

nodes.text: Oh my oatmeal... You're right! How'd `they` get here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my oatmeal... You're right! How'd [color=#e23b3b][i]they[/i][/color] get here?!

nodes.text: The guys have splintered off into two groups...

nodes.text: Who are these guys?

nodes.text: Yeah, what Meat said. Who are they, and why do we hate them?

nodes.text: Because they're some of the scummiest dudes ever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, how are you all here together? Does anyone else find that odd?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: It's not `that` odd!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] odd!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Yeah, Alexei put an invite up on Faceplace, and we all carpooled.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Seemed like a fun party... For plebeians...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I'm admittedly confused about what side to be on. I mean... Alexei, you're my friend.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: But Owen's `become` my friend!
nodes.text_bbcode: But Owen's [color=#e23b3b][i]become[/i][/color] my friend!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You're with `us`, Steve! We carpooled!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're with [color=#e23b3b][i]us[/i][/color], Steve! We carpooled!

nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Honestly, I just got out of prison, so... I'm happy to be outdoors. And happy to see my old `friend,` Owen.
nodes.text_bbcode: Honestly, I just got out of prison, so... I'm happy to be outdoors. And happy to see my old [color=#e23b3b][i]friend,[/i][/color] Owen.

nodes.text: Let's just skip the pleasantries and start this fight.

nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Alexei

nodes.text: How about this? If the Centerscore side wins, you all leave. If you win, you get to stay...

nodes.text: You're sure, Chris? I mean, these guys weren't invited.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I've seen you play. I trust you.

nodes.text: We've loved bringing you the wacky antics, the drama, and the romance of Twin Branches High (aka Centerscore).
